title: Move OpenAI/Codex provider model defaults from GPT-5 to GPT-6
description:
Move Eshyra's OpenAI/Codex provider model defaults off the GPT-5 line onto GPT-6. User direction 2026-09-29: Codex usage should be GPT-6 only (luna and sol); a model audit found the product defaults are still GPT-5.

## Current state (main @ 7452fbff; enumerate with `grep -rn "gpt-5" packages docs scripts`, excluding node_modules, dist, docs/audits, packages/core/data)
- packages/core/src/config.ts:61 DEFAULT_DM_MODEL.openai = 'gpt-5.5' (primary DM, "capability floor", overridable by ESHYRA_MODEL)
- packages/core/src/config.ts:74 DEFAULT_AUDIT_MODEL_BY_VENDOR.openai = 'gpt-5.4-mini' (mechanics audit, overridable by ESHYRA_AUDIT_MODEL)
- packages/core/src/model/evaluation.ts:524/531 evaluation candidates gptPremiumPrimary 'gpt-5.5' (premium) and gptMiniAuditor 'gpt-5.4-mini' (economy)
- packages/core/src/model/codexSdkMcpClient.ts:248 doc example `gpt-5.5`
- docs/codex-adapter.md:114 ESHYRA_PROFILE_PREMIUM_DM_MODEL=gpt-5.5 example
- tests pinning these: packages/core/test/config.test.ts:85-86, packages/cli/test/cli.test.ts:369/393, packages/core/test/codexSdkMcpClient.test.ts (constructor fixtures; 'gpt-5-codex' unsupported-model error text at ~293 is a verbatim upstream error string — leave it)
- NOT in scope: packages/core/test/captainSeats.test.ts fixtures (gpt-5.6-luna/-sol as arbitrary non-captain model strings and TOML nux keys; they select nothing).

## Decision to make first (record it in the bead notes before changing code)
Choose the GPT-6 id per role, verified against what Codex accepts on the ChatGPT-account auth path (the codexSdkMcpClient path rejects unsupported models):
- primary DM (AGENTS.md: premium frontier quality) — proposed gpt-6-sol;
- mechanics audit (bounded tool-use judgement; fast tier where one exists) — proposed gpt-6-luna (or gpt-6-astra if it is the fast/economy tier; confirm tiering from current model availability, e.g. ~/.codex/models_cache.json, rather than from name guesses).
Evaluation candidates follow the same mapping by tier.

## Acceptance
- No gpt-5* model id remains as a default, evaluation candidate, doc example, or test expectation in the enumerated files (except the verbatim upstream error string); membership re-derived by the grep above.
- ESHYRA_MODEL / ESHYRA_AUDIT_MODEL overrides behave unchanged.
- One live smoke through the Codex adapter with each new default id (not a permanent test), recorded in notes; gated live integration tests still skip without credentials.
- npm run verify:worktree green. Deliverable is a PR; bead stays in_progress until it merges.
